title: Founding Engineer
descriptionText:
We are hiring a Founding Engineer to build and scale the systems that power Maestro — in person, in Austin.
This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and operations. You will work directly with the Founder and partner closely with Product and Ops to translate real-world operational friction into reliable, AI-enabled software.
This is not a ticket-taking role. This is a builder role.
You will be responsible for shipping the automation, tooling, and AI systems that increase team capacity and improve member experience — and driving them to launch and adoption.

🎯 Mission
Maestro is building a high-touch, AI-enabled travel platform for high-net-worth members. We combine human expertise with automation and intelligent systems to deliver exceptional travel experiences — while building operational leverage that allows us to scale sustainably.
As a Founding Engineer, your mission is to turn AI and engineering effort into reliable, scalable systems that actually get used and reduce human work.
We are early, fast-moving, and intentional about who we hire. Every person we bring in meaningfully shapes the company.

🚀 The Multiplier Effect
At Maestro, we don't hire to redistribute work; we hire to create exponential leverage. Every hire must bring a unique superpower — whether that's technical judgment, systems thinking, or the ability to solve ambiguous problems under pressure. As a founding engineer, your code is the leverage: the systems you build should let the team do dramatically more without growing headcount linearly.

🏆 What You'll Do

- Ship, debug, and improve production code across the stack — backend, APIs, and AI systems

- Integrate and operationalize AI workflows (LLMs, orchestration, APIs, automation) that are stable, understandable, and trusted internally

- Translate ambiguous product and ops needs into working software

- Prioritize based on measurable business impact, in partnership with product

- Make pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, quality, and scalability

- Instrument what you build and track performance in real usage

- Reduce manual, human-heavy workflows through thoughtful automation

- Collaborate closely with our offshore engineering team — sharing context, reviewing work, and unblocking one another to keep delivery moving across time zones

You will help us move from "high-touch but manual" to "high-touch and scalable."
We hire for outcomes, not activities. In your first 3–6 months, you will:

- Ship core AI workflows and integrations that are stable and adopted internally

- Measurably reduce manual, repetitive operational work through automation

- Establish reliability in the systems the team depends on daily

- Ship consistently, with fewer blockers and surprises

- Create systems that scale as membership grows

🌱 The Maestro Core (Universal Competencies)
Regardless of the role, every Maestro team member must embody:

- High Agency: You find a way over, under, or through obstacles without waiting for permission.

- Execution Velocity: You move work forward with momentum and intentionality.

- Judgment: You make smart tradeoffs under uncertainty.

- Human-Centered Conduct: You treat people like people, even under high pressure.

- Ownership: You act like it's yours—without being told.

🧩 Are You a Stage Fit?
We are an early-stage, high-growth company. This means we value slope over pedigree.
We need productive challengers who:

- Have thrived in ambiguity and incomplete inputs before — not just tolerated it.

- Start by doing, not delegating — there are no "pure managers" here.

- Optimize for leverage before elegance, and ship "good enough" systems that are reliable and adopted.

- Admit uncertainty and ask for help early to protect team velocity.

- Take initiative without waiting for perfect clarity.

- Care about building durable systems, not just shipping features.

📚 Qualifications
Required Experience

- 4+ years building and shipping production software (full-stack or backend-leaning)

- Strong technical judgment across backend, APIs, and modern web

- Hands-on ability to ship, debug, and improve code independently

- Comfort making speed / quality / scalability tradeoffs at an early stage

- Demonstrated ownership of outcomes (not just shipping features)

Strongly Preferred

- Experience building or integrating AI-enabled products (LLMs, orchestration, AI agents, automation, ML systems)

- Experience increasing operational leverage (reducing manual work, improving capacity)

- Experience building internal tools, operational systems, or workflow automation

- Experience working collaboratively with distributed or offshore engineering teams

- Experience in high-touch service environments (marketplaces, travel, fintech, concierge, logistics, etc.)

- Comfort with metrics, instrumentation, and reliability practices

- AI-first workflow — you actively use AI to increase your own and the team's efficiency

🏢 Work Model

- In-person / hybrid role, based in Austin, TX (minimum 3 days/week in-office).

- In-person collaboration is core to how we work and learn as a team.

💸 Compensation & Growth

- Competitive salary based on experience, plus meaningful founding-level equity.

- Equity is structured to align long-term ownership with company growth.

- Significant room to grow scope and technical leadership as the company scales.

- Significant opportunity for impact and cross-functional exposure as the company grows.

🌟 Why Join Maestro?

- Founding-Level Ownership from Day One — This is not a feature-factory role. You'll own core systems and technical decisions from the start, and directly influence company direction as one of our earliest engineers.

- Build at the Inflection Point — We have paying members, real revenue streams, and strong early signal — but we're still small enough for your work to materially shape the company.

- AI Applied to Real Problems — We use AI as infrastructure — embedded into workflows that increase advisor capacity and improve high-stakes decision-making. This isn't demo AI. It's AI that moves metrics.

- High-Agency, High-Talent Team — We hire for superpowers. We move fast. We disagree without being disagreeable. You'll work alongside people who take ownership and expect the same.

- Path to Senior Leadership — This role has meaningful scope and the opportunity to grow into broader technical or engineering leadership as the company scales.

- Human-Centered Product — We're not building abstract SaaS. We're helping real people plan meaningful travel experiences — where trust, judgment, and service matter.

- Early-Stage Upside — Competitive compensation with meaningful equity. If we execute well, you share in the value created.

- In-Person Builder Energy (Austin-Based) — We believe early-stage velocity benefits from being in the room. Tight feedback loops. Fast iteration. Real collaboration.

title: Staff Hardware Engineer
descriptionText:
About ChronoSpace
At ChronoSpace, we build AI that digitizes the physical world. Today's AI models only understand the world in 2 dimensions making them impractical for the physical world.
We change that.
We are building a new kind of AI for 4-dimensional (3D + time) digitization—the capture, reconstruction, compression, and distribution of digitized physical worlds—unlocking transformative capabilities in manufacturing, robotics, and entertainment.
The Role
We are looking for a Hardware Design Engineer to join our Capture Systems team. Our highly portable multi-camera capture rig enables in-the-wild capture, allowing us to collect data where it happens, from factory floors to basketball courts. As we scale up data collection across a range of applications, we are beginning to create variations of the rig to better encompass the wide variety of settings in which we will be capturing. We will also be scaling up rig production to meet increasing demand.
In order to support these efforts, we are looking to hire an engineer who will drive the rig's mechanical design, including camera housing design and mounting solutions across rig variations and deployment settings. They will also collaborate on a strategy for increased rig production. This role involves a high amount of collaboration with the electrical design of the system.
Required Skills and Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field, with 2+ years of relevant hands-on product development experience

- Proven track record of taking physical products from concept through scaled production with rapid prototyping methods

- Proficiency in MCAD (Fusion 360 or similar)

- Applied knowledge of manufacturing techniques (injection molding, 3D printing, CNC machining, etc.) and the ability to drive material and process selection based on cost, tolerance, and performance tradeoffs

- Demonstrated experience with DFM/DFA and working with manufacturers and suppliers for component acquisition

- Electronics fundamentals, such as soldering, reading wiring diagrams, and/or experience integrating SBCs or microcontrollers into finished products

- Experience working on hardware projects within cross-functional teams preferred

Role begins in October 2026.

title: Founding Engineer
descriptionText:

You’ll work directly with the founders and customers to turn ambiguous, high-value problems into production software. You’ll have broad ownership over what we build, how we build it, and how quickly it reaches customers.

- Develop AI systems for complex, high-stakes workflows.

title: Founding Engineer
descriptionText:
About Motherboard Labs
Motherboard Labs is building the operating layer for machines in the field. We work with companies running complex fleets of robots and other autonomous machines after those machines leave the prototype stage and enter real operations.
Today, large service teams manually search across telemetry, documentation, maintenance history, and tribal knowledge to diagnose failures. When a remote fix fails, they also often send contractors with little experience with these machines to fix them in the field. This process is inefficient, leading to high fleet downtime and making scarce technical expertise a bottleneck to fleet growth.
We deploy agents in the cloud and at the edge to allow these companies to surface relevant incidents, triage issues, capture what resolved them, and turn those learnings into reusable workflows/memory across deployments. Each deployment is built around the customer’s machines, telemetry, operating rules, people, and existing stack instead of forcing every fleet into a standard software.
Our founding team is ex-Citadel Securities and ex-Palantir. We are backed by a16z speedrun and are already deployed with robotic fleets. Modern, autonomous machines are already deployed in the world today (way more than you realize), and will be everywhere in the next few years. The most expensive part won't be building them, it'll be keeping them running. We need the team to build this future with us.
The role and what we require
We’re looking for a founding engineer who can work directly with modern fleets to build specialized software while also building the shared platform underneath each deployment. This is not a one-off implementation role. The challenge is to make each deployment reflect the reality of the customer’s fleet without creating a bespoke build for every customer.
You will be employee 3 and responsible for helping to shape the architecture, product, engineering culture, and customer-deployment model. Day to day could involve 1) interviewing company employees to understand their biggest challenges, 2) building integration and agent tooling for a key customer data source, 3) optimizing harness capabilities using trace data, 4) fine-tuning specialized models for firmware error diagnosis, 5) generalizing repeated customer needs into shared services for the platform, and much more.
You will be handling the chaos of an early startup and have to navigate difficult situations with customers, product decisions, time constraints. We will all be working closely but you need agency to run your own ship when everyone is spread thin, which is often the case! We value execution, speed, and accountability.
Who we’re looking for
The exact titles you’ve held matter less than the systems you’ve owned.
You may be a strong fit if you’ve been:

- A founding or early engineer who helped deploy a product with its first enterprise customers.

- A forward deployed engineer who kept improving the platform underneath customer implementations.

- A platform or infrastructure engineer who wants to work closer to customers and end users.

- An engineer in a field where software interacts with complex real-world systems.

We are looking for candidates who:

- Strong engineering background; CS, math, software engineering, physics preferred

- Have operated cross-functionally, whether at a startup wearing multiple hats or by driving product/commercial thinking at a larger company

- Has owned and shipped meaningful software

- Can work directly with demanding customers

- Can move between deployment work and platform architecture

- Will work in person and travel to customer sites 25–50% of the time

Nice to have:

- experience in robotics, autonomy, physical AI, fleet management, industrial or warehouse automation, IoT, or telemetry and observability.

- experience building systems with strong security practices around customer data, permissions, access controls, and data isolation.

Compensation
$150-200K base + 0.5–1% equity + benefits

descriptionText:

Full-stack (AI and product engineering). The web app in React, the LLM pipelines behind it, the MCP server agents talk to, and the integrations that feed the world model. You'd work with our front-end engineer and set how product engineering runs here.
You

For the full-stack role: creative product and design mindset, LLM pipelines in production (multi-step, evals, structured output, not one API call), and experience keeping third-party integrations alive at scale. Taste, in code and in prose.
Opinionated but open-minded, whether the argument is about product experience or core architecture. We look for evidence of craft.
Mostly: you see what's broken and fix it before anyone asks.
Successful candidates have usually already shown excellence somewhere, whether in their education, work, technical projects, or how they approach applying. We reciprocate by keeping the team small and in person, with a shared high bar, so you'd learn from peers you can trust and respect.
London or SF, in the office every day. We can sponsor visas. Top-of-market cash and founding equity.

title: Founding Engineer
descriptionText:
About TAYA
TAYA is a memory company. We use AI to help people remember what actually happened: what was said, what was promised, the idea you had and lost by lunch.
Our first product is a voice-first AI you can talk to, paired with a wearable made to be worn. Most memory devices end up in a drawer because nobody wants them on their body. Ours is designed to be something you reach for, so it's there when it matters. It captures, holds onto privately, and hands back the moment you need it.
Founded by Elena Wagenmans (ex-Apple, Stanford) and backed by MaC Venture Capital, Female Founders Fund, and a16z Speedrun. We care a lot about taste: how the product looks, feels, and reads is the product. Pre-orders are open ahead of a 2026 launch.
Join us in building AI worth keeping on.
About the Role
We're looking for a founding engineer to own the software at the center of Taya: the app people open every day to capture, search, and relive their memories. We have a working iOS app today. Your job is to take it from working to indispensable.
You'll work directly with Elena, with no layers and no process, and the decisions you make now will define the product for years. This is a software-first role for someone who thinks in products, not tickets, and who measures success by whether people keep coming back.
Responsibilities

- Own and evolve the iOS app, the daily driver for someone's entire memory archive

- Own onboarding and the first-run experience: get people to their first real memory fast

- Own retention: define the metrics that matter, then build the features and loops that move them

- Build AI-powered search and retrieval that surfaces the right moment

- Improve the capture experience: tap-to-capture, backgrounding, audio handling

- Own sync between the wearable and the app over BLE

- Integrate AI services and a managed backend (Supabase or similar)

- Own a privacy architecture users can trust, on-device wherever possible

- Work with Elena across product, design, and GTM to ship, learn, and iterate

Qualifications

- 3+ years building and shipping consumer iOS software

- Strong Swift engineer; SwiftUI, AVFoundation, and the iOS platform feel like home

- Shipped at least one consumer app end-to-end, from empty project to App Store

- Taste: a strong point of view on how software should look and feel, and a track record of shipping work that shows it

- Has owned product metrics, not just features: you've moved retention, activation, or engagement and know how

- Comfortable across the stack: APIs, managed services, and frontend

- Track record of 0-to-1 building under ambiguity

- Strong opinions on privacy and data minimization

- Excellent attention to interaction detail

- AI-native: you build with Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools daily and get more done because of it

- Audio-heavy or real-time app experience is a plus

- CoreBluetooth / BLE hardware integration is a plus

- On-device ML or Core ML is a plus

Benefits

- Founding engineer equity, real ownership from day one

- Competitive seed-stage salary

- Health, vision, and dental benefits

- Direct work with the founder on a product people are already pre-ordering

title: Founding ML Engineer
descriptionText:
About the Company
Philyron is building the predictive brain for commercial fleets from tankers, cargo ships to defense vessels. We use real-time sensor data and historical maintenance records to predict and explain engine failures before they happen.
The Role
We're hiring a founding ML engineer to own the AI systems at the heart of the product. You'll work directly with the founders and own the full loop: data, training, evals, and shipping models into production.
What You'll Do

- Connectivity — get data off the ship. Ships have terrible, intermittent connectivity. You'll build the pipeline that moves sensor data from a vessel's edge device to our cloud reliably over satellite links (VSAT / Starlink) — using lightweight, fault-tolerant protocols (MQTT / Sparkplug B), with encryption in transit and graceful handling of connections that drop for days at a time and resume.
Cloud backbone — land it and make it usable. You'll stand up our cloud architecture (AWS): a real-time "hot path" that checks incoming sensor metrics against safety thresholds and fires instant alerts, and a "cold path" that stores high-frequency time-series data for trend analysis and model training. You'll also build the integration layer that pulls decades of historical maintenance records out of operators' existing CMMS databases — the data that makes our predictions possible.
Predictive fusion engine — the reason we win. This is the heart of it. You'll build the ML system that fuses two data streams almost no competitor combines: live sensor signatures and historical failure records. You'll map past maintenance events to the sensor patterns that preceded them, train anomaly-detection and failure-prediction models (e.g. isolation forests / autoencoders for anomalies, gradient-boosted trees / LSTMs for remaining-useful-life), and design the fleet-wide-plus-per-vessel modeling approach that makes predictions both accurate and personalized to each engine. The output isn't "anomaly detected" — it's "this pattern preceded a gearbox bearing failure across the fleet; inspect within 14 days."
Automated reporting. You'll build the service that compiles trends, history, and predictions into clean reports delivered to operators on a schedule — turning the platform into something that shows up in their inbox and proves its value every week.

What We're Looking For

- Evidence you've shipped ML that real users touched - in production, research, or serious projects

- Show us projects, repos, demos, side projects — real things you've designed and built end to end, ideally ones that touched both data/ML and the infrastructure around it. Your portfolio is your résumé.

- Strong fundamentals across the stack, not just notebooks

- Pragmatism: you pick the boring approach that works over the clever one that might

- Comfort owning systems end to end with no ML team behind you

Compensation & Equity
Early-stage compensation: 130 ~ 150k salary, ~1.5%
experience and location - we're happy to talk through the details early in the process.

title: Founding Software Engineer
descriptionText:
We’d love for you to join Basis.
Rapid advances in frontier AI are shaping how billions of people work, learn, & live every day. Much of this advancement is due to scaling (more compute + more/better data → better coverage over desired distributions). But, while compute spend is growing up to 4x per year, publicly available data increases by only 1.03x per year! That gap becomes even starker when moving beyond LLMs into voice, video, & the physical world. Hence, there is desperate demand for high quality, high diversity, & carefully curated recordings of human interaction and expression.
Leading labs require vast amounts of human feedback, behavior, culture, speech, & judgement. We’re already working with leading labs and have one of the largest contributor networks in the industry, to provide exactly that.
Our mission is to revolutionize the frontier of human-AI interaction through consumer products users genuinely want to use. The intelligence we provide today will power the world’s best models to better serve humanity, its interests, & its values in the long-run.
Our mission works two-ways:

- We give frontier labs access to an increasing breadth of human intelligence and experience, helping them build models that are more capable, grounded, and useful to the people they will serve.

- We give humans everywhere a meaningful role in shaping those systems and reward them for the value they create.

Why Basis will win / what we do:
This sector will only continue to grow. Yet almost all companies serving this market only operate as marketplace middlemen and temporary talent acquisition portals. Labs needs data, the vendor recruits costly contractors, & the workforce largely gets reset when the project ends. Advantages are slow to compound and there is little to nothing proprietary to keep them afloat once the sector matures and becomes fully efficient.
We are not building middleman infra between labs and contractors. We build consumer-facing products millions genuinely want to use, reward them for participating, and own the infrastructure that turns user behavior into high-quality training signals for labs, with compounding network effects, high k-factor and retention, and real-time rewards aligned with contribution quality.
We are experts in frontier multi-modal research. We collect tens of thousands of hours of recordings and millions of preference votes weekly (and growing rapidly), and have already used these to train SOTA internal models to optimize all parts of the pipelines. We allocate significant GPU resources to make the best use of our proprietary data and constantly test new training hypotheses. We will open-source and publish portions of this work to support the community and show the breadth of our expertise.
We are experts in reaching and retaining consumers. We have previously scaled consumer apps from zero to millions in ARR and have backgrounds at the best consumer companies in the world (Duolingo, TikTok, Zynga, etc.).
Our goal is to build the world’s largest consumer products for teaching AI about humanity and the real world: a connection through which frontier models can learn from millions and soon hundreds of millions of people every day. Very few companies are attempting to build this system and even fewer have the skills to actually do it. We’re confident Basis will become the defining company in this category.
Why you shouldn’t join:

- Ambiguity: We will spend considerable time teaching you everything we know about this field, our product, our needs, & our systems. Once we’ve shared the context, you’re expected to make independent decisions and lead the way through the ambiguity that comes with working on the frontier. You will become the world’s leading expert on whatever you work on here, and won’t settle for less.

- Fast Pace: We don’t expect you to work outside of our work hours (weekdays 10-8), but we do expect you to move fast, parallelize relentlessly, & get client projects across the finish line. We are competing in what is turning out to be one of the largest emerging markets and we plan to win it.

- Small Team: We’re a small team (4 full-time, 2 part-time) & hiring 2-3 in the next few weeks. If you prefer the comfortable structure of a larger company don’t join us yet!

- Evolving role: This is a startup & we’re scaling aggressively - it’s insane how much can change within just one year. We expect that everyone’s role will also evolve aggressively; you are expected to grow with the company and will need to constantly learn new things - every day brings new challenges & no two days are the same.

Why you should join:

- You’ll work on the cutting edge of frontier AI working directly with top labs. You’ll build systems/train models/do things no one has ever done before.

- You’ll work with exceptional, ambitious, & fast-moving people while having full ownership & creative control over your work.

- You’ll grow & learn a lot. Your career will accelerate with the company. Basis is well-funded from S-Tier investors and inbound, and will imminently raise a Series A (now’s the time to join!).

What you’ll do (Software Engineer):

- Build pipelines that score, filter, and rank millions of user recordings each day using in-house ML-models and custom fraud detection systems

- Design scalable systems from scratch that automatically control millions of dollars in user rewards and ad spend.

- Work directly with leading labs, assess their needs, & deliver high-quality and heavily filtered recordings for their frontier models.

- Collaborate closely with founders in a fast-iteration environment, independently owning systems end-to-end with high autonomy.

You: Enjoys system design; is very intentional & sweats the details; moves very fast with AI coding tools; loves building; thrives on solving problems no one has ever solved before.
What you’ll do (Research Engineer):

- Train state-of-the-art internal models, public benchmarks, and technical publications using the one-of-a-kind multi-modal data we collect.

- Collaborate with top researchers at leading labs to create extremely challenging open-source benchmarks to push the frontier of voice and interaction modeling.

- Example: frontier speech-to-text models still struggle with regional dialects like Moroccan Arabic. We collect tens of thousands of hours of hand-transcribed Moroccan Arabic audio and use it to train internal models that accelerate transcription and automatically verify data quality.

- Example: we collect tens of millions of preference ratings to train in-house reward models used in RL pipelines, for both enterprise clients and open-source releases/benchmarking.

You: deep conceptual understanding of deep learning; experience fine-tuning strong open models; ideally with publication track record.
What you’ll do (MTS/Research-Software Hybrid Role):

- Both of the above

Employment Details:

- 💸 Competitive compensation + equity

- 🏝 20 days PTO

- 🌺 Company retreat

- 🏥 Platinum-class medical, dental & vision insurance

- 🍱 Lunch & dinner provided every work day (weekdays, 10-8)

- 🏢 Beautiful office space in San Francisco

- 🌎 Best-in-class immigration support

- ❤️ Most importantly, the ability to work on some of the most consequential technical challenges of our time.

We'd love to hear from you. Reach out to alexis@withbasis.co with any questions!

Much of this advancement is due to scaling (more compute + more/better data → better coverage over desired distributions). But, while compute spend is growing up to 4x per year, publicly available data increases by only 1.03x per year! That gap becomes even starker when moving beyond LLMs into voice, video, & the physical world. Hence, there is desperate demand for high quality, high diversity, & carefully curated recordings of human interaction and expression.
Leading labs require vast amounts of human feedback, behavior, culture, speech, & judgement. We’re already working with leading labs and have one of the largest contributor networks in the industry, to provide exactly that.
Our mission is to revolutionize the frontier of human-AI interaction through consumer products users genuinely want to use. The intelligence we provide today will power the world’s best models to better serve humanity, its interests, & its values in the long-run.
Our mission works two-ways:

- We give frontier labs access to an increasing breadth of human intelligence and experience, helping them build models that are more capable, grounded, and useful to the people they will serve.

- We give humans everywhere a meaningful role in shaping those systems and reward them for the value they create.

Why Basis will win / what we do:
This sector will only continue to grow. Yet almost all companies serving this market only operate as marketplace middlemen and temporary talent acquisition portals. Labs needs data, the vendor recruits costly contractors, & the workforce largely gets reset when the project ends. Advantages are slow to compound and there is little to nothing proprietary to keep them afloat once the sector matures and becomes fully efficient.
We are not building middleman infra between labs and contractors. We build consumer-facing products millions genuinely want to use, reward them for participating, and own the infrastructure that turns user behavior into high-quality training signals for labs, with compounding network effects, high k-factor and retention, and real-time rewards aligned with contribution quality.
We are experts in frontier multi-modal research. We collect tens of thousands of hours of recordings and millions of preference votes weekly (and growing rapidly), and have already used these to train SOTA internal models to optimize all parts of the pipelines. We allocate significant GPU resources to make the best use of our proprietary data and constantly test new training hypotheses. We will open-source and publish portions of this work to support the community and show the breadth of our expertise.
We are experts in reaching and retaining consumers. We have previously scaled consumer apps from zero to millions in ARR and have backgrounds at the best consumer companies in the world (Duolingo, TikTok, Zynga, etc.).
Our goal is to build the world’s largest consumer products for teaching AI about humanity and the real world: a connection through which frontier models can learn from millions and soon hundreds of millions of people every day. Very few companies are attempting to build this system and even fewer have the skills to actually do it. We’re confident Basis will become the defining company in this category.
Why you shouldn’t join:

- Ambiguity: We will spend considerable time teaching you everything we know about this field, our product, our needs, & our systems. Once we’ve shared the context, you’re expected to make independent decisions and lead the way through the ambiguity that comes with working on the frontier. You will become the world’s leading expert on whatever you work on here, and won’t settle for less.

- Fast Pace: We don’t expect you to work outside of our work hours (weekdays 10-8), but we do expect you to move fast, parallelize relentlessly, & get client projects across the finish line. We are competing in what is turning out to be one of the largest emerging markets and we plan to win it.

- Small Team: We’re a small team (4 full-time, 2 part-time) & hiring 2-3 in the next few weeks. If you prefer the comfortable structure of a larger company don’t join us yet!

- Evolving role: This is a startup & we’re scaling aggressively - it’s insane how much can change within just one year. We expect that everyone’s role will also evolve aggressively; you are expected to grow with the company and will need to constantly learn new things - every day brings new challenges & no two days are the same.

Why you should join:

- You’ll work on the cutting edge of frontier AI working directly with top labs. You’ll build systems/train models/do things no one has ever done before.

- You’ll work with exceptional, ambitious, & fast-moving people while having full ownership & creative control over your work.

- You’ll grow & learn a lot. Your career will accelerate with the company. Basis is well-funded from S-Tier investors and inbound, and will imminently raise a Series A (now’s the time to join!).

What you’ll do (Software Engineer):

- Build pipelines that score, filter, and rank millions of user recordings each day using in-house ML-models and custom fraud detection systems

- Design scalable systems from scratch that automatically control millions of dollars in user rewards and ad spend.

- Work directly with leading labs, assess their needs, & deliver high-quality and heavily filtered recordings for their frontier models.

- Collaborate closely with founders in a fast-iteration environment, independently owning systems end-to-end with high autonomy.

You: Enjoys system design; is very intentional & sweats the details; moves very fast with AI coding tools; loves building; thrives on solving problems no one has ever solved before.
What you’ll do (Research Engineer):

- Train state-of-the-art internal models, public benchmarks, and technical publications using the one-of-a-kind multi-modal data we collect.

- Collaborate with top researchers at leading labs to create extremely challenging open-source benchmarks to push the frontier of voice and interaction modeling.

- Example: frontier speech-to-text models still struggle with regional dialects like Moroccan Arabic. We collect tens of thousands of hours of hand-transcribed Moroccan Arabic audio and use it to train internal models that accelerate transcription and automatically verify data quality.

- Example: we collect tens of millions of preference ratings to train in-house reward models used in RL pipelines, for both enterprise clients and open-source releases/benchmarking.

You: deep conceptual understanding of deep learning; experience fine-tuning strong open models; ideally with publication track record.
What you’ll do (MTS/Research-Software Hybrid Role):

- Both of the above

Employment Details:

- 💸 Competitive compensation + equity

- 🏝 20 days PTO

- 🌺 Company retreat

- 🏥 Platinum-class medical, dental & vision insurance

- 🍱 Lunch & dinner provided every work day (weekdays, 10-8)

- 🏢 Beautiful office space in San Francisco

- 🌎 Best-in-class immigration support

- ❤️ Most importantly, the ability to work on some of the most consequential technical challenges of our time.

We'd love to hear from you. Reach out to alexis@withbasis.co with any questions!

title: Founding Engineer
descriptionText:
About Cluster
Cluster’s mission is to become the infrastructure layer between agents and markets.
Since launching a few months ago, we’re already helping 50+ high growth startups (among them other a16z speedrun and YC startups) find and reach their best fit customers.
We are backed by a16z speedrun and are looking for people to build at the intersection of GTM and AI.
About the role
You will work directly with the founders (Enrique, Luis) in person in our Union Square office in NYC.
You’ll join customer meetings, define product requirements, build and launch features and demo to customers, take their feedback to ruthlessly improve the product.
What you’ll work on

- Build the core product, from APIs, to tasteful interfaces for humans and agents. Be independent and own major features through development and deployment.

- Deploy production ready AI features that directly impact real customer GTM workflows

- Work directly with the founders in a highly collaborative environment

- Take the latest and greatest from X and bring it into the product

- Compound the company's engineering velocity by setting up AI-native engineering workflows and processes

We’re looking for

- A cracked dev with 3+ years of experience who wants real ownership of the product & roadmap

- Python and typescript experience strongly preferred

- Solid data modeling fundamentals

- You prefer shipping fast over perfection

- You whisper to coding agents all day long but use them with judgement

- You have a growth mindset and can learn fast from feedback

- Bonus if you’ve ever run an outbound campaign

Compensation & Equity
Early-stage compensation: a meaningful equity stake plus salary. Specifics depend on experience - we're happy to talk through the details early in the process.
